env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-22T12:00:00Z

mkdir repo
exec git -C repo init -b main
exec sh -c 'printf "initial\n" > repo/README.md'
exec git -C repo add README.md
exec git -C repo commit -m initial

# The Git common directory owns one store shared by every worktree.
exec card --store repo/.git/.cardamom init --prefix common- --board-name 'Primary board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/init.txt
exec card --store repo/.git/.cardamom config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/config.txt
exec card --store repo/.git/.cardamom board create 'Linked board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/linked-board.txt

# Each worktree keeps its own selected board in its private Git directory.
cd repo
exec card board use board_00000000000000000000
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/use-primary.txt
exec git worktree add ../linked -b linked
cd ../linked
exec card board use board_11111111111111111111
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/use-linked.txt
exec card create 'Linked issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/linked-create.txt

cd ../repo
exec card create 'Primary issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-create.txt
exec card list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/primary-list.txt
cd ../linked
exec card list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/linked-list.txt

# Direct mail and topic subscriptions span board selections in one store.
cd ../repo
exec card --actor primary-agent mail send linked-agent 'direct across worktrees'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/direct-send.txt
cd ../linked
exec card --actor linked-agent mail recv
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/direct-recv.txt
exec card --actor linked-agent mail subscribe 'release.*' --ttl 1h
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/subscription.txt
cd ../repo
exec card --actor primary-agent mail publish release.ready 'topic across worktrees'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/topic-publish.txt
cd ../linked
exec card --actor linked-agent mail recv
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/topic-recv.txt

# Resource names also span board selections in one store.
cd ../repo
exec card --actor primary-agent lease acquire shared-environment --ttl 30m
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/lease.txt
cd ../linked
exec card --actor linked-agent lease show shared-environment
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/lease.txt
! exec card --actor linked-agent lease acquire shared-environment --ttl 30m
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/lease-held.txt

# A nearest store overrides Git common-directory discovery, while --store can
# select the common store explicitly.
mkdir nested
exec card --store nested/.cardamom init --prefix nested- --board-name 'Nested board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/nested-init.txt
exec card --store nested/.cardamom --board 'Nested board' config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/nested-config.txt
cd nested
exec card --board 'Nested board' create 'Nested issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/nested-create.txt
exec card --board 'Nested board' list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/nested-list.txt
exec card --store $WORK/repo/.git/.cardamom --board board_11111111111111111111 list
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/linked-list.txt
